text: 受更低的借贷成本和北京推进人民币国际化的影响，哈萨克斯坦借款人的人民币融资规模首次超过了美元融资规模。数据显示，今年迄今为止，哈萨克斯坦借款人发行的人民币债券规模已飙升至相当于34.4亿美元的水平，远高于2025年同期的4.56亿美元。而相比之下，美元融资额仅为31.6亿美元。（彭博）
text_en: Driven by lower borrowing costs and Beijing's push to internationalize the renminbi, Kazakh borrowers' renminbi financing has exceeded their dollar financing for the first time. Data shows that so far this year, renminbi bonds issued by Kazakh borrowers have surged to the equivalent of $3.44 billion, far above $456 million in the same period of 2025. By contrast, dollar financing was only $3.16 billion. (Bloomberg)
